description: Returns one task from the practice library: how AI may be used, its level, what the lawyer must review, its checkpoints, restrictions and sources, and its jurisdiction versions.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction id or slug, for example "NSW", to include that version.

task_id.description: The task id from search_library, for example "A1-A20260923-1".

name: get_task_guidance
title: Get a task’s guidance
